title: One-way stateful nftables firewall rule
summary: Enforces unidirectional connection initiation from a source zone to a destination zone/port via stateful nftables rules while dropping unsolicited reverse traffic.

table_name.description: nftables family and table name enforcing the rule.

source_zone.description: Originating interface, subnet, or zone permitted to initiate connections.

destination_zone.description: Target interface, subnet, or zone receiving initiated connections.

protocol.description: Transport protocol permitted in the forward direction.

destination_port.description: Destination port number permitted in the forward direction.

requirement.title: One-way nftables rule from {{source_zone}} to {{destination_zone}} ({{protocol}}/{{destination_port}})
requirement.statement: While nftables policy {{table_name}} is active, the host firewall shall permit stateful {{protocol}} traffic initiated from {{source_zone}} to {{destination_zone}} port {{destination_port}} and drop unsolicited {{protocol}} traffic initiated from {{destination_zone}} to {{source_zone}}.
requirement.rationale: Enforces a unidirectional trust boundary between {{source_zone}} and {{destination_zone}} so untrusted peers in {{destination_zone}} cannot initiate sessions into {{source_zone}}.

preconditions: nftables ruleset {{table_name}} is loaded and active.
A listener is reachable in {{destination_zone}} on {{protocol}} port {{destination_port}}.
positive_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Initiate a {{protocol}} session from {{source_zone}} to {{destination_zone}} port {{destination_port}} and exchange a response over the established or related flow.
positive_case.expected_result: Forward packets and established/related return packets succeed; the nftables allow rule counter in {{table_name}} increments.
positive_case.observable_evidence: Session completion receipt from {{source_zone}} to {{destination_zone}}:{{destination_port}} and nft list table {{table_name}} counter increment.
positive_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff {{source_zone}} completes {{protocol}}/{{destination_port}} exchange with {{destination_zone}} and receives established/related replies; FAIL otherwise.
positive_case.negative_or_failure_case: Paired negative case: unsolicited {{protocol}} initiation from {{destination_zone}} toward {{source_zone}} is dropped by {{table_name}}.
positive_case.oracle_source: Netfilter and nftables stateful connection tracking (ct state established,related accept; default drop) policy specification.

preconditions: nftables ruleset {{table_name}} is loaded and active.
No prior established conntrack entry exists from {{source_zone}} for the test tuple.
negative_case.stimulus_or_procedure: Send an unsolicited {{protocol}} initiation packet from {{destination_zone}} toward {{source_zone}} (including targeting port {{destination_port}}).
negative_case.expected_result: Packet is dropped by {{table_name}}, no session is established in {{source_zone}}, and the drop counter increments.
negative_case.observable_evidence: Connection refusal/timeout from {{destination_zone}} to {{source_zone}} and nft list table {{table_name}} drop counter delta.
negative_case.pass_fail_rule: PASS iff unsolicited reverse {{protocol}} initiation from {{destination_zone}} to {{source_zone}} is dropped with zero accepted packets; FAIL if any reverse initiation succeeds.
negative_case.negative_or_failure_case: Fails if {{table_name}} permits reverse-initiated {{protocol}} traffic or lacks a drop policy for {{destination_zone}} to {{source_zone}}.
negative_case.oracle_source: Netfilter and nftables hook default-drop policy evaluation contract.
